lines.text: It’s project time! Build an interactive art gallery: at least two artist sprites, each drawing a different pattern when clicked — one with a nested loop, one with a growing variable — using colours chosen on purpose.
Create at least two different patterns.
One should use a nested loop, and one should use a variable that grows.
Clicking a sprite draws a new pattern.
Choose colours, pen sizes and angles on purpose.
Small changes to numbers make big changes to the art — experiment!
Give your artist sprites click scripts so visitors can choose which pattern to see.
In your reflection, say which numbers you changed and what effect they had.
Great work! Let’s remember what we learned.
Now plan it, build it, test it, and share it!
